utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive still needs help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries. We still need folks for the tool table and one more run to pick up supplies—clear, simple jobs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the tool table and help keep things moving there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you tell me which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my drill, a set of screwdrivers, pliers, a hammer, and my tape measure, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can put together a quick supply list for the repair drive—just tell me what you need most. I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo—could you start with screws, a few paint brushes, and some heavy-duty tape? I might swing by a bit late, but I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll note screws, paint brushes, and heavy-duty tape. If you’re running late, just send word and I’ll keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m still skimming it too, but I know they’re pulling together volunteers and a donation list. I’ll send you the full details when I get them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate that. I’m still piecing it together, so the full details will help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I jump in—what time is the repair drive, and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10 a.m., and we’re meeting by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — 10 a.m. by the community center entrance. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted. Let’s make sure folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time and place should I tell people?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still confirming the exact time and spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 3:00 after school, and just bring the broken item plus any charger or parts you have.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it—3:00 after school. I’ll bring the broken item and any charger or parts I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy today, but I’d be happy to help if you remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need to sort the donation drop-off, label the boxes, and check who’s bringing tools. I’m worried we’ll run out of time if we don’t keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can handle the labels and help check on the tools. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What should I bring or do first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Mara. If you can, please bring a few sturdy boxes and help me sort the donations when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll bring sturdy boxes and help sort the donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, please put me on the list. I’ll do my best to help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you on the list. I’ll send the details your way as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—I'm still catching up on the details, though. If you know what they still need, I’d be glad to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s shaping up well—I’ll ask around and repeat the current needs to you once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out and share whatever I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything for the repair drive, or should I just show up and help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just showing up and helping would be wonderful, Mina — thank you. If you happen to have a screwdriver or a box of tape, that’d be a bonus.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll bring a screwdriver if I can find one, and I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Cleo, I’m in the middle of a few things—what’s the quick version of the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quick version: we’re collecting tools, screws, and basic fix-it supplies for the neighborhood repairs. If you’ve got extras, I can keep track of them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can probably spare some screws and a wrench. Want me to drop them off later?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I could use help setting up a table, sorting tools, and greeting folks when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the table and greeting folks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — could you start by checking which homes need the most urgent repairs and jotting down their addresses? Then we’ll match volunteers to each one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll go check the urgent ones and write down the addresses first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening—just tell me the address or the nearest landmark.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you—it's happening at the community center by Maple Park. I'll send the exact address over right away!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll note the community center by Maple Park and wait for the exact address.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good cause — I can swing by and spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be awesome, Ira — thanks for helping spread the word. I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it to folks I see today and see if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows what to bring. Let’s get a clear list of needs and a good time for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Rosa — I can help make the list and spread the word to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — let’s split it up so it stays easy to manage. I’ll draft the needs list and you can start reaching out to neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Tess—just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Sam! Could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I can sort the donated tools and watch the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Faye—let’s aim for 10 a.m. to noon on Saturday, and if you could bring a tape measure and a notepad, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—I’ll be there Saturday at 10 with a tape measure and notepad.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on today. I’ll bring my tools by later.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. See you later then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring folks together for the repair drive—do you want me to check who can lend tools or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure—can you confirm who’s actually available and what tools they can lend?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check around and see who’s free, then I’ll match up the tools they can lend. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I’ve been meaning to check on that—has something changed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s still at the community center parking lot, by the north entrance. I can point you there if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I must’ve missed that. Yeah, pointing me there would help.
